title: Just Juice Frosty Berry Ice Nic Pouches
description: Just Juice Frosty Berry Ice Nicotine Pouches offer a highly convenient and completely tobacco-free way to enjoy a steady nicotine release. Known for their exceptional e-liquid blends, Just Juice brings their flavour expertise to the pouch format, ensuring consistent quality and long-lasting taste in every tin. Available in accessible 6mg and 10mg strengths, these pouches are designed to provide a smooth, controlled experience for users seeking a reliable daily option. The Frosty Berry Ice profile delivers a vibrant berry experience with a refreshing finish. It combines the sweet, rich notes of mixed Berries with a crisp, cooling Ice element. The dark fruit notes contrast perfectly with the frosty exhale, ensuring a dynamic and highly satisfying taste from start to finish. Engineered for comfort, each pouch features a stable moisture design that prevents leakage while sitting discreetly under the upper lip. This provides a clean, smoke-free, and vapour-free experience that integrates easily into any environment. Nicotine Ranges: Low - 6mg this is best suited for new users Medium - 10mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Nicotine Pouches Please Note: Do not chew, Suck or Swallow the pouches.
